project.name: navivox
project.description: First-party HTTP/WebSocket gateway channel for the Flutter Navivox app, exposing trusted operator health, turn intake, streaming, profile-contact, memory, capability, and voice-profile surfaces inside Gormes.

nodes.name: auth.go
nodes.summary: Implements Navivox bearer-token, browser WebSocket subprotocol, Tailscale identity, and CORS authentication gates before HTTP or stream handlers can reach the gateway.

nodes.name: capabilities_test.go
nodes.summary: Characterizes the Navivox capabilities and status-link contracts, including auth-mode reflection, endpoint stability, and secret/path redaction.

nodes.name: capabilities.go
nodes.summary: Builds the stable Navivox capability document advertised to the Flutter app, including auth mode, health aliases, endpoint contracts, profile management, attachments, voice, and stream event support.

nodes.name: channel_test.go
nodes.summary: Broad integration-style test suite for Navivox HTTP and WebSocket behavior, covering auth, status, turns, streaming events, session lifecycle, CORS, VPN bind safety, and run records.

nodes.name: channel.go
nodes.summary: Owns the Navivox gateway.Channel implementation, HTTP route registration, channel send/edit methods, run-record tracking, health/status/session handlers, and JSON error shaping.

nodes.name: codemap.md
nodes.summary: Subsystem codemap documenting Navivox responsibilities, module seams, request/event flows, integration points, and package test surfaces.

nodes.name: config_admin_test.go
nodes.summary: Tests the Navivox config-admin API contract for auth, schema redaction, validation failure safety, diff reporting, reload evidence, and safe secret writes.

nodes.name: config_admin.go
nodes.summary: Provides the Navivox configuration-admin endpoint for schema, read, validation, diff, and safe apply flows with redaction and reload reporting.

nodes.name: memory_overview_test.go
nodes.summary: Verifies the memory overview endpoint requires auth and returns safe workspace, count, health, and redacted database-label information.

nodes.name: memory_overview.go
nodes.summary: Exposes a safe memory overview endpoint that reads Goncho SQLite counts and degrades with redacted database labels instead of leaking paths.

nodes.name: profile_contacts_test.go
nodes.summary: Tests auth-bounded profile-contact snapshots and sanitized WebSocket profile-contact update events.

nodes.name: profile_contacts.go
nodes.summary: Builds and maintains redacted Navivox profile-contact snapshots from known profiles, workspace config, runtime session updates, and profile metadata.

nodes.name: stream.go
nodes.summary: Implements the Navivox WebSocket stream protocol, client/session lifecycle, turn-control messages, event fanout, tool metadata redaction, and subscriber cleanup.

nodes.name: tool_events_test.go
nodes.summary: Covers structured tool-progress update streaming from the Navivox channel into subscribed WebSocket clients.

nodes.name: turn.go
nodes.summary: Normalizes HTTP and WebSocket Navivox turn requests into gateway inbound events with session IDs, request IDs, text validation, and profile-scope metadata.

nodes.name: voice_profiles_test.go
nodes.summary: Tests voice-profile redaction, provider validation, and voice-turn metadata fallback evidence used by Navivox.

nodes.name: voice_profiles.go
nodes.summary: Reads and validates profile-scoped Navivox voice-profile configuration, provider matrices, credential status references, and turn metadata fallbacks.

tour.title: Subsystem Map
tour.description: Start with the codemap to learn the Navivox channel boundary, module seams, and HTTP/WebSocket flows.

tour.title: Channel Entry Point
tour.description: Review channel.go to see how Navivox registers HTTP routes, implements gateway.Channel, tracks sessions and run records, and shapes errors.

tour.title: Auth, Stream, and Turn Intake
tour.description: Follow auth.go, stream.go, and turn.go to understand request authorization, WebSocket client/session management, and gateway inbound event enqueueing.

tour.title: App-Facing Read Models
tour.description: Inspect the capability, profile-contact, config-admin, memory overview, and voice-profile files to see how Navivox exposes trusted operator state without leaking secrets or local paths.

tour.title: Contract Tests
tour.description: Use the package tests as executable documentation for auth requirements, streaming events, config mutation safety, redaction, and voice/profile contracts.
